active_batch.next_action: Implement Phase 9d CAPTCHA classifier + structured UNKNOWN labelling. Concrete plan (see ROADMAP.md line 103 for full spec): (1) new module backend/app/captcha_signatures.py with curated regex/selector bank for reCAPTCHA v2 (`<iframe src="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor`), reCAPTCHA v3 (script src match), hCaptcha (`<script src="https://hcaptcha.com/1/api.js`), Cloudflare Turnstile (`<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile`), Datadome (`window._dd` script), AWS WAF Captcha, FunCaptcha, Geetest, generic Apache `<form action="/captcha"` pattern. (2) Add `reason: str | None` field to checker.CheckResult (default None for backward compat; expose in to_dict() + GraphQL CheckResultInfo). (3) Wire detection in checker.py main probe path: when a 200-OK body matches a CAPTCHA signature, set reason='captcha_<vendor>' and force status to BLOCKED (the existing _is_blocked_body path already returns BLOCKED for the generic case; the new module produces vendor-specific reasons). (4) Per-vendor counter surfaced via /api/admin/ml/status (new `captcha_vendors_seen: {vendor: count}` field via a small in-process ring buffer in captcha_signatures._VENDOR_COUNTS). (5) ~15 new tests in tests/test_captcha_signatures.py covering each vendor signature, false-positive guards (e.g. a site that just mentions 'captcha' in a footer link should not match), the BLOCKED+reason wiring through checker.py, and the admin counter surface. Closes residual-risk M3 (silent UNKNOWN on CAPTCHA challenge; MEDIUM).

design_decisions_locked_in.signature_format: regex over response body text (fast, no DOM parser needed); per-vendor compiled regex precomputed at import time so the hot path is O(N_vendors) per probe with N_vendors~10
design_decisions_locked_in.reason_field_design: new optional CheckResult.reason: str|None ; default None preserves byte-for-byte compatibility with all existing callers and serialised payloads (the field appears in to_dict() but downstream consumers tolerate the new key)
design_decisions_locked_in.detection_position: runs *inside* the existing _is_blocked_body branch, *not* before it, so we don't accidentally upgrade a generic Cloudflare interstitial to a more specific reason if the cookie-prewarm path already would have flagged it; CAPTCHA signature match always wins over the generic body fingerprint when both fire
design_decisions_locked_in.counter_storage: in-process collections.Counter wrapped in a threading.Lock; reset_counts_for_tests() helper for unit tests; never persisted to disk because operators only need a 'this week' snapshot, not historical analytics (Phase 9e/9f planning may upgrade to a Redis stream)
design_decisions_locked_in.admin_endpoint_extension: GET /api/admin/ml/status returns the existing payload + new captcha_vendors_seen: {vendor: count} key; no new endpoint, no SPA changes (the SPA's existing reason-code rendering was already wired in Phase 6)
